Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Female wizard (Rasmodia) Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of female wizard (Rasmodia), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Compatible with Romanceable Rasmodia and other female wizard mod. ( asked by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/60383811]nemo73446[/url].)

nemo73446 suggested [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia SVE - Female Wizard[/url] mod, I saw there are a few other female wizard mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1011]Female Wizard - Sprite And Portrait[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3205]Wizard to Witch CP Version of CreepyKat[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7440]Girl Mod for Stardew 1.5.1[/url],[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Combined Girl Mod[/url]. This portrait works for people who are using those mods too.

[b][size=3]This mod only includes the portrait.[/size][/b]

[u][size=5][b]Beauty is in the eyes of the beholder, don't like don't download.

[/b][/size][/u]Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work.
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

There are CP version, Replacement file version, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] version. Choose whichever you prefer/whichever works for you.
[s]
[/s]


The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
There are too many version of female wizard mod so I don't know who to suggest, go, endorse and love everyone.
